exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on the bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, lower it to your mid-chest, then press back up to full elbow extension.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: On an incline bench, press the dumbbells up and slightly inward above the upper chest, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: Lying flat, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc with a slight elbow bend, then bring them back together over the chest.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Set the seat so handles align with mid-chest, press forward to extension, then return under control.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: With cables set high, pull both handles down and across the body in an arc, squeezing the chest at the bottom.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels, lower the chest to just above the floor, then press back up.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.instructions: Lean forward on the dip bars, lower until shoulders are below elbows, then press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip, pull your chin above the bar, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar down to the upper chest while keeping the torso upright, then let it rise back under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bar to the lower ribs, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Support one knee and hand on the bench, row the dumbbell to the hip, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit upright, pull the handle to the torso while squeezing the shoulder blades, then extend arms back out.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull the rope toward your face, flaring elbows out and squeezing the rear shoulders and upper back.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Grip the bar outside the shins, keep the back flat, drive through the floor to stand tall, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: From the front rack, press the bar overhead to lockout, keeping the ribcage down, then lower to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Press the dumbbells overhead until arms are extended, then lower to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Press the handles upward to full extension, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward and raise the dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing the rear shoulders at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Keeping elbows fixed at your sides, curl the bar up to shoulder height, then lower under control.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the EZ bar up while keeping elbows still, squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: With palms facing each other, curl the dumbbells up while keeping elbows fixed, then lower.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the bar attachment up toward the shoulders keeping elbows fixed, then lower under tension.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Keeping elbows pinned to your sides, push the bar down to full extension, then let it rise under control.

exercises.name: Lying Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Lying on the bench, lower the bar toward your forehead by bending only the elbows, then extend back up.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind your head, then extend arms back up.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.instructions: Hands on the bench behind you, lower your hips toward the floor, then press back up to full elbow extension.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.instructions: With the bar on your upper back, squat down until thighs are at least parallel to the floor, then drive back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercises.instructions: With the bar racked on the front shoulders, squat down keeping the torso upright, then drive back up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Lower the sled until knees approach 90 degrees, then press through the heels back to the start.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward into a lunge until both knees reach roughly 90 degrees, then push off into the next step.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: With the rear foot elevated on the bench, lower until the front thigh is parallel to the floor, then drive back up.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend the knees to lift the pad until legs are straight, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the kettlebell at chest height, squat down between your knees, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: Squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor keeping the chest up, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: With a slight knee bend, hinge at the hips lowering the bar along the legs, then drive the hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the pad toward your glutes by bending the knees, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Good Morning
exercises.instructions: With the bar on your back, hinge forward at the hips keeping a flat back, then return to standing.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: With upper back on the bench and the bar over your hips, drive through your heels to lift the hips up, then lower.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, drive through your heels to raise your hips, squeeze glutes, then lower.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: With the cable attached at the ankle, kick the leg back and up while keeping the torso stable, then return.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as possible, pause, then lower your heels below the step.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: With weight on your knees, raise your heels as high as possible, pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms and toes, bracing your core, for time.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hanging from the bar, raise your legs to hip height or higher without swinging, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneeling below the cable, crunch down by curling the torso toward the hips, then return under control.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sitting with feet lifted, rotate the weight from side to side while keeping the chest up.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Balance on one forearm and the side of one foot, keeping hips lifted in a straight line, for time.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.instructions: Hinging at the hips over the pad, lower your torso forward, then raise back to a straight line with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: Hinge at the hips to swing the kettlebell back, then snap the hips forward to drive it to chest height.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.instructions: Holding the band at shoulder height, pull it apart by squeezing the shoulder blades together, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.instructions: Resting forearms on your thighs, curl the wrists up, then lower under control.
